title: MAVLink binding for the Common Command Registry

registryCommands.note: Mission item `NAV_WAYPOINT`: `holdTime` → param 1, `acceptanceRadius` → param 2, `heading` → param 4. MAVLink param 3 is a fly-by radius (0 = pass through), so `passThrough` has no exact counterpart. Guided use: `DO_REPOSITION`.
`CONDITION_YAW` for a heading; `NAV_SET_YAW_SPEED` for rover-type yaw and speed.
No direct command. Commonly realized by `DO_PAUSE_CONTINUE` or a mode change.
`DO_CHANGE_ALTITUDE`. Underwater vehicles in MAVLink-based stacks use a negative relative altitude as depth; there is no depth frame.
`DO_CHANGE_SPEED`: `speedType` → param 1, `speed` → param 2, `throttle` → param 3. An absent optional value is sent as -1 ("no change").
`COMPONENT_ARM_DISARM`; `force` is carried in the magic-number parameter.
`DO_PAUSE_CONTINUE` with pause; `mission.resume` uses the same command with continue.
Composite. `surface` has no `MAV_CMD` and is listed as unsupported.
Message streaming is controlled with `SET_MESSAGE_INTERVAL`; this is a message-rate control, not a sensor command in the strict sense.
Servo- or gripper-based release: `DO_GRIPPER` or `DO_SET_SERVO`, depending on the airframe.
